stills.prompt: Extreme close-up at table height on a near-black charcoal stone surface like the stone of @hall. A fine antique-gold (#C6A94F) chain runs taut through a narrow chiselled groove cut into the stone and bends sharply around the edge of a deep dark fissure that crosses the groove; one worn, brighter link is snagged on the fissure's edge, the chain pulled tight behind it. The groove is polished smooth by wear. Shallow depth of field: the snagged link sharp, the groove curving away into darkness. The only light is a single warm pool from above, its source out of frame. Near-black surroundings, strong gold-on-black contrast readable at phone size. No lantern in frame, no people, no hands, no glow, no sparks, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.

A low, narrow vaulted chamber of near-black charcoal block stone like @hall, almost dark. In the foreground a long rectangular table of the same dark stone. A fine antique-gold (#C6A94F) chain lies in a carved closed oval groove on the near half of the tabletop, circling three deep dark cracks in the stone. The far half of the tabletop is bare. In the far wall, an arched doorway opens onto darkness. One enclosed brass lantern hangs low above the table, the only light, a warm pool on the tabletop; the walls fall away into shadow. Low camera at the table's near end. No daylight, no pale stone, no people, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
